subject: general
question:
The following graph shows the month-wise cumulative progress in the construction of a dam. If the progress in July is equal to that of the highest progress recorded in any month in the given period, how much work will be completed by the end of July?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1000b5bc53c3a220f333c54916923b856b72e10ca9cd12a50c0b004c1ce0a1b.png]
solution:
**Given:**

The graph shows the cumulative progress of dam construction over the months, with July's progress equal to the highest progress recorded in any previous month.

**Formula used:**

Total progress by the end of July = Cumulative progress by June + Highest monthly progress

**Calculations:**

From the graph:

Cumulative progress by June = 44%

Highest monthly progress = 12% (from March)

Total progress by the end of July = 44% + 12% = 56%

**∴ The total work completed by the end of July is 56%.**
